end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation from cell to organism.
Yash initially omitted organ system, then corrected the order after discussing heart, blood, and vessels.
Identified heart as an organ and digestive system as an organ system.
Gave examples for cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism; discussed Amoeba as single-celled.
The dependence-between-parts homework question remained unclear.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, and organism, and used heart, blood, and vessels to distinguish an organ from an organ system. They first mixed up the order by leaving out organ system, but corrected it later in the lesson. At home, ask them to explain one system using “parts and their jobs,” such as the circulatory system: heart pumps, blood carries, and vessels provide pathways.
